user.title: Tankerkönig Mobile
user.description: The home location is taken from the Home Assistant configuration.

data.pause_zones: No queries on the road in these zones

data_description.tracker_entity: device_tracker (or person/zone) with latitude/longitude attributes. Required for prices on the road.
data_description.station_filter: Station IDs or brands, separated by comma or newline. Empty = all stations.
data_description.scan_interval_min: Regular polling interval. Tankerkönig allows at most one request every 5 minutes.
data_description.move_threshold_km: Fetch immediately once the vehicle moved further than this since the last query.
data_description.pause_zones: While the vehicle is inside one of these zones, no prices are fetched on the road (last data is kept). Entering a zone triggers an immediate home update.
data_description.fixed_times: Local times (HH:MM) at which prices are always fetched, separated by comma or newline, e.g. 12:00, 12:05.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tankerkönig API.
error.no_location: Enable at least one location (home or on the road).
error.tracker_required: Select a location entity for prices on the road.
